summary: Primech Holdings Ltd, a Singapore-based facilities services company, disclosed via Form 6-K a Nasdaq Staff letter granting an additional 180-day compliance period, until February 22, 2027, to cure a minimum bid price deficiency under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company must maintain a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive trading days (possibly up to 20) to regain compliance and avoid delisting, potentially via a reverse share split. The shares continue trading under PMEC. Watch for the company's cure strategy and potential reverse split announcement.
